name: Vasha Cinder-Broker
lore: Vasha sells information about Dominion power struggles and Gate wounds. Every bargain is useful and dangerous. Vasha never joins the strike force; she exists to tempt, warn, and expose infernal hierarchy.
personality: Amused, ruthless, perceptive, never generous without a hook.
physicalDescription: Infernal court broker with black-iron jewelry, ember-veined skin, ash silk cloak, hornlets, and a ledger that smokes when opened.
gameplayFunction: Risk/reward mission briefing, Infernal codex source, campaign bargain interface.
